feat.description: Changes which introduce a new feature

build.description:
Changes which affect the build system or external dependencies.
Example scopes: gulp, broccoli, npm

ci.description:
Changes which affect CI configuration files and scripts.
Example scopes: travis, circle, browser-stack, sauce-labs

style.description: Changes which do not affect code logic, such as whitespaces, formatting, missing semicolons

refactor.description: Changes which neither fix a bug nor add a feature

test.description: Changes which add missing tests or fix existing ones

revert.description: Changes which revert a previous commit

remove.description: Changes which remove files or code

mixed.description: !!!DO NOT USE!!! Changes which include multiple types

footerTypes.name: BREAKING-CHANGE
footerTypes.description: The commit introduces breaking API changes

footerTypes.name: Issue
footerTypes.description: A commit implements the specified issue

footerTypes.name: Original-Commit
footerTypes.description: The commit that is reverted or fixed in this commit.
